summary: Diageo plc filed its Form 6-K furnishing its Annual Report for fiscal year 2026, dated August 18, 2026. The filing contains routine annual performance disclosures including net sales of $19.6 billion, operating profit of $3,156 million, and a recommended dividend. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change is announced. The report includes standard strategic, governance, and financial statement sections, reflecting ordinary reporting obligations for a foreign private issuer. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or unusual structural mechanics to analyze. This is a routine annual report filing with no special-situation implications.
